import sys, json, ctypes, itertools
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/vendor'); sys.path.insert(0,'/tmp/dev')
ctypes.CDLL('/workspace/vendor/system-libs/libz.so.1', mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
from netnomos.finite import compile_job
from brute import bf_compile_job
from ref2 import ref2_compile_job

def check(name, job, expect_rules=None):
    a=compile_job(job); b=bf_compile_job(job); c=ref2_compile_job(job)
    ok = (a==b==c)
    print(f'{"OK " if ok else "FAIL"} {name} rules={len(a["rules"])} active={len(a["active"])}')
    if not ok:
        print(json.dumps(job))
        print('GOT ',json.dumps(a)); print('BF  ',json.dumps(b)); print('REF2',json.dumps(c))
    if expect_rules is not None and len(a['rules'])!=expect_rules:
        print(f'  !! expected {expect_rules} rules, got {len(a["rules"])}', json.dumps(a['rules']))
    return a, ok

# 1. universe of size 1 (single field, single value domain)
job={'fields':[{'name':'a','type':'flag','domain':[0]}],'slots':1,
     'predicates':[{'kind':'cmp','left':{'ref':[0,'a']},'op':'eq','right':{'const':0,'type':'flag'}}],
     'width':1,'train':[[[0]]],'approved':[[0]],
     'queries':[{'fixed':[],'target':[0,'a'],'prefix':''},{'fixed':[],'target':[0,'a'],'prefix':'0'},
                {'fixed':[],'target':[0,'a'],'prefix':'1'},{'fixed':[],'target':[0,'a'],'prefix':'01'}]}
check('universe size 1', job, 0)

# 2. tautology predicate excluded (ge min domain)
job={'fields':[{'name':'a','type':'count','domain':[3,7,9]}],'slots':1,
     'predicates':[{'kind':'cmp','left':{'ref':[0,'a']},'op':'ge','right':{'const':3,'type':'count'}},
                   {'kind':'cmp','left':{'ref':[0,'a']},'op':'le','right':{'const':9,'type':'count'}}],
     'width':2,'train':[[[3]],[[9]]],'approved':[[0],[1],[0,1]],
     'queries':[{'fixed':[],'target':[0,'a'],'prefix':''}]}
r,ok=check('universe tautologies excluded', job, 0)

# 3. always-false predicate can never appear
job={'fields':[{'name':'a','type':'count','domain':[3,7,9]}],'slots':1,
     'predicates':[{'kind':'cmp','left':{'ref':[0,'a']},'op':'eq','right':{'const':1000000,'type':'count'}},
                   {'kind':'cmp','left':{'ref':[0,'a']},'op':'ne','right':{'const':7,'type':'count'}}],
     'width':2,'train':[[[3]],[[9]]],'approved':[[0,1],[1]],
     'queries':[{'fixed':[],'target':[0,'a'],'prefix':'7'},{'fixed':[],'target':[0,'a'],'prefix':'0'}]}
a,ok=check('always-false predicate', job, 1)
print('   rules', json.dumps(a['rules']))

# 4. cmp of two constants
job={'fields':[{'name':'a','type':'count','domain':[1,2]}],'slots':1,
     'predicates':[{'kind':'cmp','left':{'const':1,'type':'count'},'op':'lt','right':{'const':2,'type':'count'}},
                   {'kind':'cmp','left':{'ref':[0,'a']},'op':'eq','right':{'const':1,'type':'count'}}],
     'width':2,'train':[[[1]],[[2]]],'approved':[[0],[0,1]],
     'queries':[{'fixed':[],'target':[0,'a'],'prefix':''}]}
a,ok=check('const-const cmp', job)
print('   rules', json.dumps(a['rules']), 'answers', json.dumps(a['answers']))

# 5. duplicate train windows
job={'fields':[{'name':'a','type':'count','domain':[0,1,2]}],'slots':1,
     'predicates':[{'kind':'cmp','left':{'ref':[0,'a']},'op':'le','right':{'const':1,'type':'count'}},
                   {'kind':'cmp','left':{'ref':[0,'a']},'op':'ge','right':{'const':1,'type':'count'}}],
     'width':2,'train':[[[0]],[[0]],[[2]],[[2]],[[1]]],'approved':[[0,1]],
     'queries':[{'fixed':[],'target':[0,'a'],'prefix':'1'},{'fixed':[],'target':[0,'a'],'prefix':''}]}
a,ok=check('duplicate train rows', job)
print('   rules', json.dumps(a['rules']), 'answers', json.dumps(a['answers']))

# 6. big value 1000000 and long prefixes
job={'fields':[{'name':'a','type':'size','domain':[0,999999,1000000]}],'slots':1,
     'predicates':[{'kind':'cmp','left':{'ref':[0,'a']},'op':'ge','right':{'const':1000000,'type':'size'}}],
     'width':1,'train':[[[1000000]]],'approved':[[0]],
     'queries':[{'fixed':[],'target':[0,'a'],'prefix':'1000000'},{'fixed':[],'target':[0,'a'],'prefix':'999999'},
                {'fixed':[],'target':[0,'a'],'prefix':'9999999'},{'fixed':[],'target':[0,'a'],'prefix':'100000'},
                {'fixed':[],'target':[0,'a'],'prefix':'1'},{'fixed':[],'target':[0,'a'],'prefix':''}]}
a,ok=check('large values / long prefixes', job, 1)
print('   answers', json.dumps(a['answers']))

# 7. sum with one ref and scale zero; sum across slots
job={'fields':[{'name':'a','type':'count','domain':[0,1]},{'name':'b','type':'count','domain':[0,2,4]}],'slots':2,
     'predicates':[{'kind':'cmp','left':{'sum':[[0,'a']]},'op':'eq','right':{'const':1,'type':'count'}},
                   {'kind':'cmp','left':{'scale':0,'ref':[1,'b']},'op':'eq','right':{'const':0,'type':'count'}},
                   {'kind':'cmp','left':{'sum':[[0,'a'],[1,'a']]},'op':'eq','right':{'const':1,'type':'count'}},
                   {'kind':'cmp','left':{'scale':2,'ref':[0,'b']},'op':'eq','right':{'const':4,'type':'count'}}],
     'width':3,'train':[[[1,0],[0,4]],[[0,4],[1,0]],[[1,2],[0,4]]],'approved':[[0,1],[2],[3],[0,1,2]],
     'queries':[{'fixed':[],'target':[1,'b'],'prefix':'4'},{'fixed':[{'ref':[0,'a'],'value':1}],'target':[1,'b'],'prefix':''}]}
a,ok=check('sums and scales', job)
print('   rules', json.dumps(a['rules']))

# 8. any/all with K=4
job={'fields':[{'name':'a','type':'count','domain':[0,5]}],'slots':4,
     'predicates':[{'kind':'any','field':'a','op':'ge','value':5},{'kind':'all','field':'a','op':'ge','value':5},
                   {'kind':'any','field':'a','op':'eq','value':0},{'kind':'all','field':'a','op':'ne','value':5}],
     'width':2,'train':[[[5],[5],[0],[0]],[[0],[0],[0],[0]],[[5],[5],[5],[5]]],'approved':[[0,2],[1],[3]],
     'queries':[{'fixed':[],'target':[3,'a'],'prefix':'5'},{'fixed':[],'target':[3,'a'],'prefix':''}]}
a,ok=check('any/all K=4', job)
print('   rules', json.dumps(a['rules']), 'answers', json.dumps(a['answers']))

# 9. wide domain in a single cell (65536 values) - only engine vs ref2 (brute too slow)
import numpy as np
dom=list(range(0,65536*4,4))[:65536]
job={'fields':[{'name':'a','type':'count','domain':dom}],'slots':1,
     'predicates':[{'kind':'cmp','left':{'ref':[0,'a']},'op':'ge','right':{'const':100,'type':'count'}},
                   {'kind':'cmp','left':{'ref':[0,'a']},'op':'le','right':{'const':200000,'type':'count'}}],
     'width':2,'train':[[[100]],[[200000]],[[4]]],'approved':[[0,1]],
     'queries':[{'fixed':[],'target':[0,'a'],'prefix':'10'},{'fixed':[],'target':[0,'a'],'prefix':'0'},
                {'fixed':[],'target':[0,'a'],'prefix':''},{'fixed':[],'target':[0,'a'],'prefix':'0001'},
                {'fixed':[],'target':[0,'a'],'prefix':'65536'}]}
a=compile_job(job); c=ref2_compile_job(job)
print(f'{"OK " if a==c else "FAIL"} wide domain 65536 rules={len(a["rules"])} answers={json.dumps(a["answers"][:4])}')
EOF
